artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan pinning the .orchestrator-handoff.json artifacts[] element shape in one normative place, propagating it by reference into five agent contracts plus wrap-up.md, and hardening validate-handoff.sh Check 2c.

memory_candidates.content: When a schema-adjacent prohibition exists only as an implicit consequence of a required-fields list (or only inside a JSON Schema that no ad hoc validator actually evaluates), it drifts in practice. The durable fix pattern used in this agent system is four-layered and each layer is individually insufficient: (1) one explicit negative prose sentence in a single normative doc, (2) a validator that type-checks the element before indexing into it and names the index plus observed type in its failure message, (3) a consumer chokepoint that normalizes loudly and records a defect class rather than silently degrading, (4) agent contracts that reference the normative section rather than restating the field list. When only some layers exist, name the missing ones as explicit deferrals instead of assuming the structural rule is enforced.
